scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Brasilis^000000, a country as passionate as the sun.
If you have any questions, please ask me.

[巴西向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513巴西^000000，这个如太阳般热情的国度。
有什么问题，尽管问我。
